definition: 69 reviewed source URLs, with explicit read scopes; a record is not necessarily a complete paper. Sources from the same project are not independent corroborating origins. Publication dates are separate from retrieval, copyright, revision and event dates. No source count proves research quality.

sources.title: LTU Applied AI programme
sources.read_scope: official programme; full visible programme description
sources.finding: 120 credits, with 30-credit AI thesis. Company/research-group work is described as a choice, not a mandatory partner requirement.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: LTU X7013E syllabus
sources.read_scope: complete four-page official PDF, extracted locally
sources.finding: Independent systematic investigation; justified method, literature survey, report and defence. Individual work is preferred. This is the Spring 2027 syllabus, not a guarantee of the user's applicable cohort or examiner approval.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: DCASE 2026 proceedings
sources.read_scope: proceedings listing and task-1 report abstract
sources.finding: Current heterogeneous audio classification work already uses strong multimodal representations; a thesis must compare against them.
sources.date_basis: Official linked proceedings record S67; webpage bibliography itself gives October 2026.

sources.title: DCASE heterogeneous audio task
sources.read_scope: task definition, data, baseline and evaluation sections
sources.finding: BSD10k includes audio plus title/tags/description and hierarchy. Precomputed CLAP features support small learned adaptation; official dev baseline uses random folds.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: BSD10k release metadata
sources.read_scope: Official record JSON, full metadata CSV/license counts, archive directory and one decoded NPY
sources.finding: Separate feature archive 49,346,956 bytes. Numeric (512,) float32 embedding decoded. Metadata audit: 10,956 rows, 2,481 uploaders; 9,304 CC0/CC-BY examples remain after excluding NC/Sampling+ for the initial study.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: SheetSage2
sources.read_scope: Introduction, architecture/structured-decoding sections, related work, limitations and impact statement
sources.finding: Music transcription already has structured decoding and distillation alternatives; does not establish a laptop-feasible full model training plan.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: GuitarSet release
sources.read_scope: Record JSON, archive directories, microphone WAV prefix and one complete solo JAMS
sources.finding: CC-BY-4.0; 360 annotation/audio files. One 34.9-second solo contains 78 notes and 24.26 seconds with exactly one active annotated note; this verifies a narrow monophonic route, not whole-corpus suitability.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: GuitarSet annotation offset issue
sources.read_scope: entire issue and one visible comment; latest update 2024-10-23
sources.finding: Two named comp tracks have known annotation offsets. Author reported updating documentation; do not describe this as a new bug or assume labels were patched.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: CREPE model documentation
sources.read_scope: complete README and model sizes/training-data limitations
sources.finding: Pretrained monophonic pitch model supports tiny capacity and 16 kHz audio. GuitarSet polyphony must be filtered, not passed off as monophonic ground truth.
sources.date_basis: CREPE is 2018 background; README first-publication date not established.

sources.title: CREPE license
sources.read_scope: entire license
sources.finding: MIT code/project terms. Keep attribution and inspect any checkpoint-specific terms when pinning the downloaded release.
sources.date_basis: License includes copyright year; that is not verified original publication.

sources.title: AICOS-HAR paper
sources.read_scope: publisher early-access page and abstract; methods unavailable in visible page
sources.finding: 106 participants and diverse devices/body positions make placement shift relevant. The article's license is not used as dataset-license evidence.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: AICOS-HAR dataset
sources.read_scope: Official metadata plus archive README, all 5,231 metadata rows and bounded accelerometer sample
sources.finding: CC-BY-4.0; 2.54 GB archive supports selective Range reads. Metadata confirms 106 participant IDs; Hand/Leg/Hip have 88/55/27 participants respectively. Units and nanosecond timestamps documented. Complete sensor member subsequently decoded and parsed: 10,996 rows, 110.15 seconds, approximately 99.82 Hz.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: PAMAP2
sources.read_scope: full primary dataset description, variable table and license
sources.finding: CC-BY-4.0; nine people, wrist/chest/ankle signals. Orientation columns invalid and missing values present. Legacy ZIP server ignored Range; large download was stopped.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: HARNET documentation
sources.read_scope: complete README
sources.finding: Frozen wearable feature encoder is usable for adaptation; classifier must be trained. Five-second model expects 3 axes x 150 at 30 Hz.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: HARNET license
sources.read_scope: entire license
sources.finding: Academic/noncommercial use only. Research can be scoped accordingly; this is not evidence of commercial model rights.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: Waste classification study
sources.read_scope: Introduction, architecture, experiments, limitations and data-availability section
sources.finding: Collection differs from TACO. Data statement says data are included in article, but no reusable image corpus/license/file manifest was established. Do not treat it as accessible training data or reproduced performance.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: TACO documentation
sources.read_scope: complete README, dataset directory and annotation schema/counts
sources.finding: 1,500 images and 4,784 annotations in current JSON. Rare categories and background variation support grouped study; annotation licenses array is empty. Parsed 4,296 scene-label rows covering 1,496 images; 690 images have differing scene-label sets across rows. Treat these as multiple judgments requiring consensus, not a single unquestioned background label.
sources.date_basis: TACO paper/project is older background; README first-publication date not established.

sources.title: TACO release and license
sources.read_scope: official dataset record JSON
sources.finding: Collection is released CC-BY-4.0; ZIP is 2,719,810,615 bytes. Preserve collection attribution; per-image metadata does not independently document rights.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: TACO code license
sources.read_scope: entire license
sources.finding: MIT software license is distinct from the dataset's CC-BY record.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: HASY dataset
sources.read_scope: record JSON plus bounded compressed archive prefix and CSV schema
sources.finding: 34,597,561-byte archive, primary record says ODbL. Sample CSV contains user_id, but source paper warns this is not a reliable person identifier. Bounded six-MB compressed prefix yielded one complete 277-byte 32x32 PNG, fully decoded.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: HASY paper
sources.read_scope: Data creation, label semantics, evaluation baselines, class difficulties and verification challenge
sources.finding: Writer IDs are unreliable; some distinct semantic labels share a glyph. Existing verification challenge already tests unseen symbols. Proposed contribution must be incremental adaptation/forgetting, not claiming unknown-symbol recognition is new.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: WildHandBench
sources.read_scope: introduction and dataset overview only
sources.finding: Contemporary handwriting evaluation covers realistic document variation; it does not itself validate symbol-level incremental learning or a HASY writer split.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: UiPath OCR release notes
sources.read_scope: September 23, October 5 and October 14 entries and surrounding release history
sources.finding: Several handwriting/confidence problems are explicitly fixed, and confidence can change without recognition-output changes. Record as resolved counterevidence, not an unfixed vendor opportunity.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.
sources.resolution_status: documented_fixes_released; not an unresolved bug claim

sources.title: Omni Parse Bench
sources.read_scope: README scoring/results/provider requirements and complete official October 8 announcement
sources.finding: Current benchmark has tagged text/table/layout tests and per-source data rights. Public announcement October 8 verified directly; repository created October 9. It motivates slice-aware evaluation, not re-running paid/GPU systems.
sources.recency_role: current alternative tied to October 8 announcement
sources.date_basis: README original publication unknown; official announcement date is independently verified in S51.

sources.title: DocLayNet data
sources.read_scope: complete README, schema, official splits and download sizes
sources.finding: 80,863 pages/11 labels. The 30,012,083,650-byte core ZIP supports Range access; 13.08 MB of directory/sample data read. Train annotation JSON is 565 MB uncompressed/81.8 MB compressed; future subset builder must stream it rather than materialize all pages. A complete 763,103-byte PNG passed ZIP CRC and image decode at 1025x1025; full COCO metadata was not downloaded.
sources.date_basis: Dataset is a 2022-era release; README first-publication date not established.

sources.title: DocLayNet license
sources.read_scope: entire CDLA-Permissive 1.0 license
sources.finding: Computational use/results allowed; preserve attribution/license for distributed enhanced data.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: Table Transformer
sources.read_scope: README task definition, caveats and weight table
sources.finding: Table detection checkpoint is DETR-R18 about 110 MB. Existing multidomain adaptation work and separate OCR requirement are acknowledged.
sources.date_basis: Related paper first submitted 2021-06-08; README first-publication date not established.

sources.title: Table Transformer weight card
sources.read_scope: entire card plus repository MIT license
sources.finding: Model card tags MIT and explains PubTables1M training. It detects table regions; it does not transcribe cell values.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: TabAlign
sources.read_scope: Introduction, alignment method, experimental design, results, limitations and effective-sample appendix
sources.finding: Hidden-activation alignment and CPU training of aligners already exist. Some effective-sample summaries exclude non-superior-teacher slices. New study will retain every condition and test output-level calibration plus minority context coverage.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: TabICL
sources.read_scope: README through fine-tuning and model version tables
sources.finding: Current default v2 supports CPU, but large GPU timings do not establish laptop runtime. Set one ensemble/context cap explicitly; local fine-tuning already exists.
sources.date_basis: README explicitly reports TabICL v2 release 2026-02-12; README first-publication date unknown.

sources.title: TabICL code license
sources.read_scope: entire BSD license section; forecast subdirectory separate Apache notice
sources.finding: BSD-3-Clause code; official jingang/TabICL weight card separately confirms BSD-3-Clause. Forecast subdirectory has separate Apache terms.
sources.date_basis: Copyright/year is not source publication date.

sources.title: Dry Bean
sources.read_scope: full dataset page, license and first 12 KB CSV download
sources.finding: 13,611 examples, 16 features, seven classes, CC-BY-4.0. Direct no-login CSV access confirmed.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: Online Shoppers
sources.read_scope: full dataset page, license and first 12 KB CSV download
sources.finding: 12,330 sessions, imbalanced target, CC-BY-4.0. Exclude PageValues for a pre-purchase prediction claim; month is not an exact timestamp.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: OneShot
sources.read_scope: Method, temporal/scoring-set appendices, corruption evidence and Appendix O scope table
sources.finding: Already evaluates corrupted confirmations, fixed event order and past-only normal selection. Initial noise/temporal gap withdrawn. Trained cross-series combiner lies explicitly outside its fixed-pool/no-training setting; proposed study compares that with event-timing metrics.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: NAB data documentation
sources.read_scope: Complete data README, one CSV prefix and complete label-window JSON
sources.finding: 58 series include 47 real series in five source families; 35 real series have at least two annotated windows. A causal first-event/support-versus-later-test protocol is structurally possible; labels are benchmark windows, not incident logs. A complete 4,032-row AWS series was fetched and parsed; 47 real series/35 with at least two labelled windows counted from complete window JSON.
sources.date_basis: NAB is older background; current data README publication date unknown.

sources.title: NAB project and current license
sources.read_scope: complete current MIT license plus project README
sources.finding: Current official repository is MIT, despite old AGPL references elsewhere. Retain attribution and provenance for included data.
sources.date_basis: Current license copyright range 2014–2024 is not a publication date.

sources.title: TSAD benchmark criticism discussion
sources.read_scope: original post and all expanded visible discussion through end of thread; collapsed replies not fetched
sources.finding: Author distinguishes criticism of benchmark triviality from all methods; commenters describe simple SPC alternatives. No formal resolution or independently reproduced comparison. Relative age only, so not a verified 30-day lead.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: Small Agents with Semantic Search
sources.read_scope: Introduction, retrieval interface, training data/decontamination, experiments and limitations
sources.finding: Uses a 17M LateOn-Code-edge retriever and larger trained agents. The retriever itself is a feasible current baseline; proposed study adapts its small projection, without teacher API trajectories or agent training.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: CodeSearchNet documentation
sources.read_scope: complete README, resources inventory and license statement
sources.finding: Corpus source licenses live in per-language _licenses.pkl; MIT code/documentation is not blanket corpus permission. Official split is repository-disjoint; human relevance judgments exist.
sources.date_basis: CodeSearchNet's 2019 introduction is background, not verified current README publication date.

sources.title: CodeBERT weight card
sources.read_scope: entire card
sources.finding: Trained on CodeSearchNet. A downstream benchmark on that corpus cannot be labelled pretraining-unseen merely because adaptation splits are disjoint.
sources.date_basis: 2020 model introduction is background, not verified model-card publication date.

sources.title: MiniLM sentence encoder
sources.read_scope: model card, license metadata, truncation and training-data table
sources.finding: Apache-2.0 compact encoder; training table includes code-search examples. Same contamination caveat applies; 256-wordpiece truncation must be measured.
sources.date_basis: 2021 model release context, not verified model-card publication date.

sources.title: Timestral release
sources.read_scope: release description, sizes, adaptation offering
sources.finding: New 5M-209M forecasters are a recent lead, not proof of a gap. Official adaptation offering is Forge; no paid service is part of this study.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: Winder demand study
sources.read_scope: complete study, methodology, caveats, code/data links and later FAQ
sources.finding: Author tests on public data and acknowledges pretraining exposure and actual future weather. Residual/covariate approaches already exist; propose a narrower controlled study, not the invention of hybrid forecasts.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: Chronos-Bolt Tiny
sources.read_scope: complete model card and license
sources.finding: 9M parameters, Apache-2.0, CPU path explicit. AutoGluon already offers covariate regressors; a new thesis must compare with that class of approach.
sources.date_basis: Chronos-Bolt's older model release is background; card original-publication date not independently established.

sources.title: Bike Sharing
sources.read_scope: primary page/license and bounded CSV download
sources.finding: CC-BY-4.0, dated hourly observations. Casual and registered counts sum to target and must be excluded; future observed weather is not a known-ahead input.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: Task-UtilityIQA
sources.read_scope: official abstract/history plus introduction
sources.finding: Original date is September 30 despite October aggregator listings. A position paper with a small study, not proof of deployed quality gains.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: GitHub daily Trending
sources.read_scope: public rendered listing fetched directly after web tool restriction
sources.finding: Observation date only; mostly agent/skills projects. Popularity alone provides neither a thesis question nor demand evidence.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: GitHub weekly Trending
sources.read_scope: public rendered listing fetched directly
sources.finding: Same-day and weekly listings are overlapping signals, not independent demand. No industrial data access follows from stars.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: Public LinkedIn DCASE notice
sources.read_scope: full publicly visible post; no logged-in access or comments
sources.finding: Conference notice corroborates a research community. Original post timestamp was not reliably visible; event date must not be substituted for publication date.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: MobileNetV3 small weight card
sources.read_scope: model card including license, feature-extraction role and resource statistics
sources.finding: Apache-2.0 card, 2.5M parameters and 224-pixel inputs; feasible frozen-feature candidate, with actual runtime still unmeasured.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: OmniParseBench official announcement
sources.read_scope: Complete public blog fetched directly after web tool could not open it
sources.finding: Original date verified. Tagged tests, derivation provenance, vendor-created benchmark and API/GPU alternatives discussed.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: LateOn-Code-edge model card
sources.read_scope: License, architecture, training-corpus list and retrieval/reranking usage; numerical benchmark table not independently reproduced
sources.finding: Apache-2.0, 17M backbone with 48-dimensional token representations. Training includes CodeSearchNet, so contamination must be acknowledged.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: TabICL weights
sources.read_scope: Complete official weight card and no-login model API metadata
sources.finding: BSD-3-Clause weight license confirmed; no weights downloaded.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: Requests source/license
sources.read_scope: Entire Apache-2.0 license; models.py sample parsed without execution
sources.finding: Sample models.py contains 52 functions, 31 with docstrings. This supports a directly licensed source corpus rather than blanket-MIT claims for CodeSearchNet.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: scikit-learn source/license
sources.read_scope: Entire BSD-3-Clause license; base.py sample parsed without execution
sources.finding: Sample base.py contains 42 functions, 26 with docstrings; source explicitly carries BSD SPDX header.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: pandas source/license
sources.read_scope: Entire BSD-3-Clause license and source/docstring section in core/frame.py
sources.finding: Third directly accessible source project; full-corpus count and per-file exceptions remain acquisition checks.
sources.date_basis: Original publication date not reliably established; no recency claim inferred.

sources.title: MovieLens 100K terms
sources.read_scope: Complete primary README/license, schema and bounded rating-file sample
sources.finding: 943 users/1,682 films/100,000 ratings. Research allowed with attribution; no redistribution or commercial use without separate permission. No partner is needed to download for research.
sources.date_basis: Historical 1997–1998 ratings collection; current README publication date unknown.

sources.title: MovieLens 1M terms
sources.read_scope: Complete primary README, complete ZIP README/movie member, and complete ratings member parsed in memory for data feasibility only.
sources.finding: Verified 1,000,209 ratings, 6,040 users and 3,883 movie metadata rows. Ratings transfer 5.82 MB; no raw rating archive saved. A temporal cohort supports 1,811 later users, with substantial timestamp ties. Research terms forbid redistribution/commercial use without separate permission.
sources.date_basis: Users joined in 2000; current README publication date unknown.

sources.title: DeepCommerceRec
sources.read_scope: Introduction, graph/sequence fusion, training/inference, evaluation setup, discussion/limitations and data availability
sources.finding: Cold-start fusion and temporal splitting already exist. Uses a GPU-based workstation and offline benchmarks; does not establish production engagement. Proposed study is a CPU-bounded adaptation with popularity/first-rating controls.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: Intent-guided diffusion recommendation
sources.read_scope: Publisher accepted-article abstract, date and stated dataset list only

sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.title: LightGCN
sources.read_scope: Method equations, training objective and ablation rationale; displayed version July 7 2020
sources.finding: Only initial user/item embeddings are trained; graph propagation is linear. Practical lower-complexity comparator for a frozen-item/new-user adaptation study.
sources.date_basis: Original publication/release or donation date reported by the cited primary source; partial dates retain their stated precision.

sources.finding: Metadata gates/dropout and uploader-disjoint evaluation already exist. HATR attention baseline and conservative audio-parent gating must be compared. Proposed contribution narrowed to controlled reliability/coverage/CPU-budget evaluation; no new-gate or new-leakage-discovery claim.
